primary_title: STAT3 suppresses transcription of proapoptotic genes in cancer cells with the involvement of its N-terminal domain
decision_basis: The review identifies unphosphorylated STAT3 binding at proapoptotic genes including CHOP; the cited primary demonstrates STAT3-dependent occupancy and repression of the CHOP/DDIT3 regulatory region in cancer cells.
limitations_preserved: Unphosphorylated STAT3 binding and STAT3-dependent repression support a bounded cancer-cell gene-level repression edge; preserve STAT3 N-terminal/chromatin-accessibility and tumor-cell context, and do not infer canonical pY705 signaling, DDIT3 protein, apoptosis in every state, SCI or terminal-TF effects automatically.
